waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Workspace

candidates.score_note: Long mean duration on home wait step indicates user drop-off during rendering, but lack of support emails keeps evidence moderate.

sign_in.hint: Taking longer than usual? Click here to reload login providers.

candidates.title: Desktop Readiness Notification Alert

home_intro.body: We will pop up a desktop notification when your pet arrives on screen.

guard.reason: Valid notification option added to home intro.

candidates.score_note: Finish step mean time of 5815s shows users leave the app unattended; notifications can re-engage them.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Pet Choice
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to occur after pet pick and photo upload steps, right before certificate finalization.
